hiruma.staging: cold wind and a low scout's crouch

traveler.performance: Low and alert. Gaze scans first, hips compress, and feet land fast and quiet.
traveler.skill_cluster: Razor's Edge, scout reads, yari leaps, and Earth stances. Map and satchel are useful props.

kakita.staging: one clean cut, turn, optional brim touch

traveler.performance: Reserved and upright at rest. Small hand motions prepare an abrupt decisive release.
traveler.skill_cluster: Focus, draw, hat-brim finish, and one narrow Void line. Hold the clean cut for a beat.

kitsuki.staging: glasses catch the light, evidence markers resolve one by one

traveler.performance: Curiosity arrives as a small head turn. Confirm with glasses, a page or one pointed finger.
traveler.skill_cluster: Deduce and Interrogate share a read. Use disciplined wrists and stance changes in Mirumoto actions.

akodo.staging: planted command gesture, staggered Lion standards

traveler.performance: Level gaze and proud chest. Command from the feet up, with firm shoulders and a short signal.
traveler.skill_cluster: Stagger the formation standards from her hand, and resolve a charge with a grounded forward finish.

isawa.staging: small finger counters converge into a five-element seal

traveler.performance: Pause to count fingers and check the count. Attention sharpens on release.
traveler.skill_cluster: Use both hands for counted spell beats. Keep Water smooth, Earth weighty, Fire abrupt and Void quiet.

shosuro.staging: a layered shadow conceals the first step, not the impact

traveler.performance: Make the first gesture a feint. Reveal the real hand and gaze only when the effect lands.
traveler.skill_cluster: Misdirection, powder, outfit-specific sleeve use, and the knife return read like stagecraft.

ide.staging: open hands, a measured breath, gold ripples

traveler.performance: Warm eye line and generous open hands. Take time to breathe and include the party.
traveler.skill_cluster: The Heart Listens opens both arms into a rising drawn heart. S543 is a separate showy vocal performance.

ronin.staging: low center of gravity, a hand-ground medicine pouch

traveler.performance: Grounded and pragmatic. Work with compact hands and follow through like someone used to weather.
traveler.skill_cluster: A pouch ties herbs and dressing together. Pilfer is swift and modest. Return notice to the fight.

hida.staging: delayed, full-body tetsubo turn, dust and shock ring

matsu.staging: shoulders drive a committed charge, rust-gold afterimage

shiba_yojimbo.staging: catch into a planted cross-guard, ember ward

seppun.staging: tall guard with ivory edge light, little recoil

yoritomo.staging: low shoulder-led sweep with a close spray

shinjo.staging: passing draw or shot, trail of dust

doji.staging: brief blade-written Justice, then a diagonal closure cut

tamori.staging: grounded invocation with coarse earth fragments

togashi.staging: inking wake, a rising Eastern dragon, a full-screen fire sweep
